questions.question: Q: A 12 V supply drives 150 mA through a resistor. Calculate its resistance showing full working.
questions.correctAnswer: R = V/I = 12/0.150 = 80 Ω. (Convert 150 mA to 0.150 A first.)

questions.question: Q: A 9 V battery powers a 4.5 V, 0.5 W Zener diode regulator. Calculate the series resistor value if the load current is 40 mA and Zener current is 10 mA.
